messages:
Maria L.: heads-up — hitting weird 429 spike in the onboarding sample app when running embed+paginate with concurrency=4. only happens on python SDK.
Kevin T.: repro? logs?
Maria L.: repro steps: start sampleapp, run `./run_onboard.sh --concurrency 4 --mode embed-paginate`, after ~30s we see backpressure + a stream of 429s. log excerpt: ```2024-03-12T18:23:41Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds detail=quota_exceeded client_window=4```
Sam R.: interesting — JS SDK keeps the window at ~1 per worker, python seems to `drain` tokens aggressively then sleep, causing synchronized bursts. could be how the leaky-bucket timer is implemented.
Jen P.: what's user impact? is this blocking live onboarding or just the sample app?
Maria L.: mostly blocks sample app demos and a few customers integrating via python because their clients spawn multiple connectors in parallel. reproducer attached.
Kevin T.: thanks. quick check — python SDK default smoothing interval is 250ms, JS is 100ms. mismatch could explain burst alignment. can you paste the client config?
Maria L.: config snippet: ```client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., concurrency=4, throttle_window_ms=250)```
Ryan H.: short-term mitigation: set default throttle_window_ms to smaller (e.g., 80ms) and add jitter to refill. long-term: align semantics across SDKs — token-bucket with per-worker fairness.
Sam R.: agree. also suggest making pagination worker honor per-page token reservation so a multi-page job doesn't consume the whole window at once.
Kevin T.: i'll open a PR for py SDK to change to token-bucket + jitter and add a compatibility test against the JS SDK harness.
Maria L.: PR would be great. for immediate demo fix i patched sample app to `throttle_window_ms=80` and added `max_tokens_per_request=1`, seems stable for 10k rows.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/eng -> staging (build 7832) :rocket:
Jen P.: can we add a short note in the onboarding guide about recommended concurrency defaults for each SDK? customers keep copy/pasting configs.
Kevin T.: yes — i'll add a section and the new compat test. also adding an integration test that runs 4 concurrent paginators against a mock endpoint to assert no synchronized bursts.
Maria L.: leaving the reproducer and logs in the sampleapp repo under `examples/onboard/throttle-repro`. tagging @Kevin T. and @Sam R. for follow-ups. thanks all :thumbsup:
